name: Shinkon Seikatsu
source: As birth rates decline, the government plans to create apartments are fully funded with a condition that your family needs to help the government to increase birth rates. To ensure that happens, they have created a robot to guide them but, unfortunately, nobody noticed that its computer brain is defective...
translation: 随着出生率持续下降，政府计划建设由公共资金全额负担的公寓，入住条件是住户家庭必须协助政府提高生育率。为了确保计划落实，他们还制造了一个负责指导居民的机器人；遗憾的是，没人发现它的电子脑存在缺陷…
